info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Operational Service By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows for the modification of customer billing operational services using a specified parameter. It enables businesses to keep billing information up-to-date by applying changes directly to the designated customer’s service. Common use cases include adjusting billing addresses, updating payment methods, or modifying service tiers. By integrating this API, developers can create dynamic billing management solutions tailored to customer needs.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update billing information for a specific customer identified by their unique ID (CUST-100045). You can modify various fields related to the customer's billing details.

requestBody.description: Updates the billing information for the customer with the specified ID. This request body should include the fields that need to be updated, adhering to the predefined schema.

200.description: Request processed successfully; the resource is updated.
